meta.conventions: I_a, I_b are PEAK leg-current amplitudes (as written in the plan's reference i_k = I_a cos(...)); phasors are peak; the RL load is per leg, star, isolated neutral; a, b are signed orders (leg k lags k 2 pi a / m).

closed_form.general_measured_data: P_sum(f_a+f_b) = |1/2 sum_k (V_ak I_bk + V_bk I_ak)|, P_diff(|f_a-f_b|) = |1/2 sum_k (V_ak conj(I_bk) + conj(V_bk) I_ak)|; V, I = complex peak FFT phasors of leg pole voltage and leg current; function pulsation_from_phasors()
closed_form.symmetric: P_sum = (m/2)|V_a I_b + V_b I_a| if m | (a+b) else 0; P_diff = (m/2)|V_a conj(I_b) + conj(V_b) I_a| if m | (a-b) else 0; for an RL load V = Z(f) I
closed_form.ripple: decoupled source: dV_pk = P/(2 pi f V_dc C); general: dV_pk = (P/V_dc)|Z_C || Z_source|

dead_time_asymmetric.note: per-leg dead time 300 ns x (1 + spread [1,-1,0.5,-0.5,0]), no current-loop rejection (worst)

frequency_choice.note: With f_a = 50, f_b = 30 Hz the combination -2 f_a + 6 f_b also equals f_a + f_b = 80 Hz, with order -2a + 6b = 10 (divisible by 5), so leg nonlinearities can alias onto the 80 Hz bin. Prefer incommensurate test frequencies, e.g. f_b = 31 Hz (sum 81 Hz, difference 19 Hz), and FFT windows that are integer multiples of 1/gcd.

sensitivity.capacitance: dV_pk scales as 1/C (see dV_pk_V_vs_C per point): C = 0.5 / 1 / 2 mF -> x2 / x1 / x0.5

load_imbalance_pm5pct.note: current-controlled legs: currents stay ideal, the leg voltages differ by Z_k -> residual cross power

dead_time.note: rejection = fraction of the dead-time voltage error removed by the current loop (1 = ideal). The uncompensated part creates current harmonics at combination frequencies; their cross power with the main voltages is the main measurement risk for the m = 5 null. Diode-conduction loss pulsation is included but is small.

source_decoupling.note: The pulsating current P/V_dc splits between C and the DC source. A stiff lab supply absorbs part of it and lowers dV. Either decouple the source (series L or R with |Z_s| >> 1/(2 pi f C): at 20 Hz, C = 1 mF -> 1/(wC) = 8 Ohm) or measure both the capacitor current and the source current and compare their sum with P/V_dc. The pass criterion should use the current, not dV, if the source is not decoupled.

recommended_points.rule: modulation feasible; predicted ripple between 0.5 V (measurable) and 10 % of V_dc (safe), smallest listed C that achieves it
recommended_points.safety_note: At C = 1 mF the plan's 10 A points give up to +-48 V ripple at 100 V (difference term at 20 Hz). Use 5 A first, or a larger film C, and prefer the 81/19 Hz frequency pair. The 5-leg null cases (1,2) use the same load and current as their 5-leg controls (1,-1) and (1,1).
